plain: To limit or put firm boundaries on

webster.text: Literally, to draw a line round.

more.text: To inclose within a certain limit; to limit, bound, confine.

example.quote: This qualifying construction, therefore, would have little, if any, tendency to circumscribe the power claimed under the latitude of the term "general welfare."
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
